cap: Girls start with thelarche and reach menarche about 2 to 3 years later, with the growth spurt early in puberty. Boys start with testicular enlargement to 4 mL, and their growth spurt comes late, about two years after girls. Bars show typical ages; the order matters more than the exact age.
teach: Peak height velocity is about 8 cm a year in girls, near breast stage 3, and about 9.5 cm a year in boys, at genital stage 3 to 4. Spermarche, the first ejaculation containing sperm, comes in the same stages, at about age 13. Pubertal gynecomastia, seen in about half of boys, begins at genital stage 3 to 4 and fades within a year or two.
